title: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove the second Kahn–Kalai conjecture. For every finite simple graph H with h ≥ 1 edges and at most n vertices, the threshold for $`G(n,p)`$ to contain an ordinary copy of H is at most $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$, where C is universal. Here $`p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)`$ is the least density at which every subgraph of H has expected copy count at least one half.
